beats.label: VALUE
beats.narration: Low or old transmission fluid changes how the valve body applies pressure, and that alone can cause hard, delayed, or slipping shifts.
beats.visualPrompt: Extreme macro of a transmission dipstick tube in an engine bay, subtle heat shimmer, warm engine glow, slow orbital camera move around the dipstick cap, no visible hands or faces, photorealistic automotive macro cinematography
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.label: VALUE
beats.narration: Warm and running, pull the dipstick. It should be pink or red, not brown, and right at the fill line.
beats.visualPrompt: Extreme macro split composition: a drop of clear pink-red transmission fluid on a white cloth beside a drop of dark brown transmission fluid, static locked shot with subtle rack focus shift between the two drops, clean neutral studio-style lighting, no visible hands or faces
